verdict.rationale: Klaviyo ships its own AI agents (Composer, Customer Agent), so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question for this product. The evidence covers only the opposite role: Klaviyo's own MCP server, which external clients like Claude or Cursor connect to. Nothing shows Klaviyo acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from servers users add, so the server evidence earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
